text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Don't be. Thank you for trying your<n>best for my
sisters!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
That said... you're not the sort to<n>throw in the towel.
I'm sure you'll be<n>trying again before long, right?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Hehe. You'll win one next time, I just<n>know it!
